(2) Two more men enter from the stalls behind the kneeling figure. One man wears a black t-shirt and dark shorts, while the other is dressed in a grey tank top and blue denim jeans. They move forward with exaggerated, rhythmic steps and strike poses leaning toward the camera. The setting remains the clean, sterile environment of the restroom. (3) The three men begin a synchronized dance routine, performing sharp arm movements and hand gestures in unison. The man in the tank top takes the lead position in the foreground. Their facial expressions are energetic and engaged as they perform. A promotional graphic banner appears at the bottom of the screen. (5) The performance concludes as the men break into fits of exaggerated laughter. They clutch their stomachs, bend over, and point at each other with wide-mouthed expressions of joy. The camera remains static as they move naturally within the frame, showcasing a high-energy ending to the choreographed segment.
